markdownLabelInjection.rationale: Most Markdown-looking Mermaid label nodes still include quote/backtick delimiters, while Helix has no Neovim-style offset directive. YAML frontmatter remains safely injectable.

injections.rationale: Every family accepts the shared frontmatter preamble; delimiter-free frontmatter_content ranges are injected as combined YAML.

indents.rationale: The family is flat, record-oriented, or scanner-indented without a nested parent range that Helix's indentation traversal can use coherently.

textobjects.rationale: The family diagram/body pair provides class.around/class.inside and direct body children provide entry.around.

folds.rationale: Helix 25.07.1 does not load folds.scm; folding is selection-driven and has no Tree-sitter fold-query ABI.

tags.rationale: Helix 25.07.1 does not load tags.scm; Tree-sitter tag captures are not an editor-native symbol source.

brackets.rationale: Helix 25.07.1 uses language auto-pair configuration and syntax traversal, not brackets.scm.

outline.rationale: Helix 25.07.1 has no outline.scm loader; document symbols are provided through editor/LSP paths.

brackets.rationale: Helix 25.07.1 uses language auto-pair configuration and syntax traversal, not brackets.scm.

outline.rationale: Helix 25.07.1 has no outline.scm loader; document symbols are provided through editor/LSP paths.

injections.rationale: Every family accepts the shared frontmatter preamble; delimiter-free frontmatter_content ranges are injected as combined YAML.

locals.rationale: The current family CST does not expose a stable diagram-local definition/reference split; labels and record values are not treated as lexical locals.

indents.rationale: The family is flat, record-oriented, or scanner-indented without a nested parent range that Helix's indentation traversal can use coherently.

textobjects.rationale: The family diagram/body pair provides class.around/class.inside and direct body children provide entry.around.
